newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P assigns ratings to GECC's HK unit.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns ratings to GECC's HK unit.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Thursday it has assigned its "A-Plus" long-term local-currency and "A" long-term foreign-currency counterparty credit ratings to General Electric Capital Finance Ltd (GECF), the Hong Kong-incorporated unit of General Electric Capital Corp.
The agency also assigned its "A-1" short-term local and foreign currency counterparty ratings to the company.
S&P said the ratings on GECF chiefly reflect the financial strength of its parent, GECC, which is rated "AAA" by the agency.
The ratings also reflect the strategic importance of the subsidiary to the parent and the good financial profile of GECF, it added.
The company's market position was small with reported total asset of HK$4.5 billion at year-end 1995, it said.
